BETA Close X Ninety One PLC has announced the repurchase of 526,775 ordinary shares between July 13 and July 17, 2026, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. The purchases were executed by J.P. Morgan Securities plc, with the lowest price paid per share being 215.4000 GBp and the highest at 220.0000 GBp, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 218.5767 GBp across these transactions. The company intends to cancel these repurchased shares, and following these transactions, Ninety One PLC holds no shares in treasury, with 662,983,236 ordinary shares currently in issue. Morgan Securities plc. Date of purchase Number of ordinary shares purchased Lowest price paid per share (GBp) Highest price paid per share (GBp) Volume weighted average price paid per share (GBp) 14 July 2026 110,613 219.6000 220.0000 219.9350 16 July 2026 208,243 217.6000 220.0000 219.2925 17 July 2026 207,919 215.4000 219.6000 217.4636 Such purchases form part of the Company's existing share buyback programme (the Programme ) and were effected pursuant to the instructions issued to J.P. Morgan Securities plc by the Company on 3 June 2026 as announced on 3 June 2026. The Company intends to cancel the purchased shares. Since 3 June 2026, the Company has purchased 5,689,164 shares at a cost of £12,208,446.02. Following the above transaction, the Company holds none of its ordinary shares in treasury and has 662,983,236 ordinary shares in issue This figure may be used by shareholders as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine whether they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, the Company under the Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules of the Financial Conduct Authority. This announcement does not constitute, or form part of, an offer or any solicitation of an offer for securities in any jurisdiction. Morgan Equities South Africa (Pty) Ltd About Ninety One Ninety One is an independent investment manager, founded in South Africa in 1991. It operates and invests globally and offers a range of active strategies to its global client base. Ninety One is listed on the London and Johannesburg Stock Exchanges.
